text: “Sing, O barren woman, you who never bore a child; burst into song, shout for joy, you who were never in labor; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband,” says the Lord.
stretch your tent curtains wide, do not hold back; lengthen your cords, strengthen your stakes.
your descendants will dispossess nations and settle in their desolate cities.
Do not fear disgrace; you will not be humiliated. You will forget the shame of your youth and remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.
the Lord Almighty is his name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; he is called the God of all the earth.
as if you were a wife deserted and distressed in spirit— a wife who married young, only to be rejected,” says your God.
but with deep compassion I will bring you back.
I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the Lord your Redeemer.
when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So now I have sworn not to be angry with you, never to rebuke you again.
and the hills be removed, yet my unfailing love for you will not be shaken nor my covenant of peace be removed,” says the Lord, who has compassion on you.
I will build you with stones of turquoise, your foundations with sapphires.
your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
and great will be your children’s peace.
Tyranny will be far from you; you will have nothing to fear. Terror will be far removed; it will not come near you.
whoever attacks you will surrender to you.
who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its work. And it is I who have created the destroyer to work havoc;
and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and this is their vindication from me,” declares the Lord.
